newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse at new record high.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse at new record high.

text.p: 1145 GMT - German shares end bourse trade at new record higher but off highs after volatile session due to expiry of DAX and stock options. DAX index surged to new life-time high in bourse at 3,798.94 points and 3,801.35 in IBIS DAX computer trade. Firmer dollar and overnight Wall Street gains, along with higher German debt prices, underpins share market.
* 30-share DAX ends bourse up 39.00 points at 3,788.27. IBIS DAX up 5.12 points at 3,782.68 points.
* June DAX futures final price at 3,801.95 points.
* Goldman raises EPS estimates for Deutsche, Dresdner and Commerzbank.
